items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Wins Ad Changes On Weight Loss Drugs And Recasts Its Pipeline
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) has intensified legal and regulatory pressure on providers of compounded Tirzepatide+ weight loss drugs, challenging safety and marketing claims. The drugmaker has secured changes to a competitor's advertising for compounded Tirzepatide+ products after raising concerns about product integrity and patient protection.
